title: Streamline Telco — Save Desk
description: Ask in plain English about postpaid subscribers at risk of churning, why, what to offer them and how much revenue is at stake. Synthetic data.
instructions: This space serves Streamline Telco's retention team. gold.save_list has one row per postpaid subscriber: churn_probability (0-1, next 60 days), risk_band (Low/Medium/High/Critical), value_at_risk_eur (= annual_value_eur * churn_probability), driver (network/price/contract/service), next_best_offer and top_reasons. 'At risk' means risk_band IN ('High','Critical'). 'Mentioned switching' means switch_intent = 1. 'Revenue at risk' means SUM(annual_value_eur) for the selected subscribers unless the user says 'expected', then SUM(value_at_risk_eur). Always sort at-risk lists by value_at_risk_eur descending. Never return transcript text; it is masked for this audience.
sample_questions: How many subscribers are High or Critical risk, and how much annual revenue do they represent?
Which region has the most at-risk subscribers because of network problems?
Show the 10 subscribers with the highest value at risk and what we should offer them
What is the churn rate for customers who mentioned switching on a care call vs. those who did not?
Churn rate by plan, highest first

trusted_sql.question: Revenue at risk by band
trusted_sql.sql: SELECT risk_band, COUNT(*) AS subscribers, SUM(annual_value_eur) AS annual_revenue_eur, SUM(value_at_risk_eur) AS expected_loss_eur FROM streamline_telco.gold.save_list WHERE risk_band IN ('High','Critical') GROUP BY risk_band
